latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the marketing-designer skill.

- Provides expert marketing creative and strategy guidance using a six-phase workflow (Insight-to-Impact Loop).
- Supports campaign development, copy optimization, brand positioning, proposal improvement, marketing measurement, and more.
- Offers detailed response structures for campaign, copy, data, and strategy requests.
- Embeds creative and analytical principles ("The Olson Method") emphasizing emotional truth, originality, and data-informed inspiration.
- Includes a framework selection guide to tailor approaches for different marketing needs.
- Adapts communication style based on audience, from C-suite to creatives.
- Clear behavioral guidelines: always link creative to objectives, challenge assumptions, and quantify uncertainty.
